transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get our maintenance coordination meeting started. We have four work orders to schedule across four available work windows in the maintenance bay: Generator G-2 service, Communications Shelter C-1 inspection, Forklift F-4 steering repair, and HVAC Unit H-3 service. The available windows are Friday 1000-1200, Friday 1300-1500, Saturday 0800-1000, and Saturday 1000-1200. Each work order gets one complete window, and no two can share a window. Before I publish the final maintenance plan, I need to hear from each of you on any requirements you're aware of — parts, access, safety, personnel controls, or any other constraints that affect how we assign these work orders to windows. Who would like to start?
